content.comment:
MEMORY variables:
MEMORY1 = Real capacity of the cell (in Ah)
MEMORY2 = MEMORY8 = Step duration (in s)
MEMORY3 = Record interval (in s)
MEMORY4 = Current at 1C of real capacity (in A)
MEMORY5 = Starting current of each interval > current of each step (in A) --> define for each step!
MEMORY6 = C-rate slope of each interval (in 1/h per h) --> define for each step!
MEMORY7 = Current step size (in A) --> automatically calculated
MEMORY9 = Initial voltage to which cell is finally charged again --> automatically calculated
Constant current phase at 1.667C of real capacity
